utokyo.name: UTokyo
utokyo.model: High-trust, precision-manufacturing innovation state with deep engineering talent but constrained domestic energy.
utokyo.advantages: Deep talent pool, world-class supply chains, strong international reputation and rule-of-law credibility.
utokyo.constraints: Energy importer (low domestic energy), aging society slows political appetite for risk.

nus.name: NUS
nus.model: Small, exceptionally open and well-capitalized research hub that thrives on global flows of talent and capital.
nus.advantages: Very high research openness, strong treasury (finance hub), high public trust and reputation.
nus.constraints: Small state: limited domestic energy and thin supply-chain depth, exposed to global shocks.

hkust.name: HKUST
hkust.model: Capital-rich logistics and finance gateway sitting between major blocs, with fast money but contested autonomy.
hkust.advantages: Strong treasury and logistics-grade supply chains; agile access to global markets and capital.
hkust.constraints: Caught between blocs: volatile security exposure and lower autonomous political support.

snu1.name: SNU-1
snu1.model: Fast-follower-turned-leader with heavy industry, nuclear-backed energy, and export-driven tech champions.
snu1.advantages: High technology progress, deep manufacturing supply chains, energy-secure (nuclear baseload).
snu1.constraints: Export dependency and heavy industry create environmental pressure and external vulnerability.

snu2.name: SNU-2
snu2.model: Centralized, security-first governance with strong internal control and energy autonomy but limited external integration.
snu2.advantages: High national security, strong centralized political support, self-reliant energy posture.
snu2.constraints: Closed system: low international reputation, low research openness, thin treasury, low external public trust.
